tool_input.command:
cd /private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec120/fx/system-spec && python3 -I -c '
import json
s=json.load(open("spec-state.json"))
qa={q["id"]:q for q in s["qa_log"]}
m=s["matrix"]
cats=[c["id"] if isinstance(c,dict) else c for c in s["categories"]]
print(cats)
for cat in cats:
    md=open(cat+".md",encoding="utf-8").read()
    cell=m[cat]["web"]
    ids=[cell["qa_ref"]]+list(cell.get("qa_refs",[]))
    for i in ids:
        q=qa[i]
        da=q.get("design_applications") or []
        dok=[ (d.get("rationale","") in md, all(t in md for t in d.get("tradeoffs",[])), d.get("decision") or d.get("status")) for d in da] if i==cell["qa_ref"] else "-"
        print(cat,i,"Q",q["question"] in md,"A",q["answer"] in md,"DA",dok,"sup",q.get("superseded_by"))
    for p,c in m[cat].items():
        if p!="web": assert c["state"]=="対象外", (cat,p)
print("other platforms all 対象外 OK")
'
